ACQP.name: Acquirer Processor
ACQP.definition: Entity providing acquiring card payment processing services on behalf on an acquirer.

CISP.name: Card Issuer Processor
CISP.definition: Entity providing issuing card payment processing services on behalf on an issuer.

CSCH.name: Card Scheme
CSCH.definition: Entity defining rules and procedures for card payment transactions acting as an intermediary between an acquirer and an issuer.

SCHP.name: Card Scheme Processor
SCHP.definition: Entity providing card payment processing services acting on behalf of a card scheme.
